title: Page 2
content_zh:
所有人都喜欢漂亮女生，杜绢也不例外，喜欢这个女孩，是人之常情。
「不喜欢天雨，怎不改名字叫天晴，天天放晴，不是很棒？」她随口攀谈。
顿时，女孩甜甜的笑脸渗进一丝苦味，扯了扯嘴角。
「我也想啊，可是天晴……会让某个人很伤心。」下一秒，她又扬起漂亮的小脸说：「叫我小雨吧，我的朋友都叫我小雨。」
「好吧，小雨。」杜绢对她笑笑，把抽屉里的洋芋片拿出来请客，她猜小雨饿坏了。
但小雨看见洋芋片，只显得很折磨，想吃又不
只不过是一包零食，值得这样犹豫踌躇？「怎么了，怕我下毒？」杜绢笑问。
「不，我养成习惯了，吃完零食，我会……吐。」
她睁圆眼。「吐？」
「不要骂我，我知道这是坏习惯，以后，会慢慢改的。」小雨抱着头，很可怜的讨饶。
才一下子，两人就熟了起来。
「你打算安排所有有耐心的女人和我见面？」
蒋誉的声音把杜绢的注意力拉回来，眼光重新落在他身上，只见他的眉毛挑了挑，不爽的臭脸又出现，熏得她满脸灰。
他讨厌矫揉造作，把自己弄得很可怜的女人，也讨厌精明能干、暗地使手段的女人，更讨厌虚情假意、扮傻装弱的蠢女人……总之，他讨厌女人。
没错，他讨厌女人，尤其是那种找上门、锲而不舍、又说服杜绢替她讲话的女人！
「如果我有权力的话。」杜绢微笑。
「很好，永远手表。可以下楼了。
「是，我去通知那位小姐，你要下班不能见她。真可怜，为了见你一面，她中午都没吃，猛喝开水填肚子。」她把文件摆在臂弯处，低低喃念着。
以为这样他就会同情心大发？错，苦肉计对他没效。
「以后，不要再拿这种事烦我。」他的脸很臭、非常臭，距离他三公尺、不知情的人士，会误以为污水处理场就在左右。

「知道。」杜绢叹气，关上门。
蒋誉把杂志收进抽屉，顺手把抽屉里的合照拿出来。
只看一眼！他对自己这么说，但这一眼，让他再也移开不了脚步，心酸泛滥成灾。
他的晴天还好吗？快乐吗？幸福吗？那里真有吃喝不完的可乐、棒棒糖？那里的男人真的泛滥成灾，让她当武则天当得很爽快？那里的太阳真的不晒人，让她大方丢掉隔离霜？
时间在他身上打住，照片里的小女生对着他微笑，恍惚间，他听见她的笑声。
她的笑声像刚破壳的小鸡，笑脸满满的都是温暖，捧起她暖暖的脸，就像捧了毛绒绒的金黄色小鸡。
那时候，她躺在他臂弯里，努着嘴巴问：「哪天我不在，你会不会想我？」
想啊，怎么不想，夜里想、日里想，想得心底破了个大洞，冷飕飕的风从那里吹进来，灌得他失温。
蒋誉苦笑，温柔的眼神里有一抹哀戚。
轻轻地，他把照片收回原位，细心谨慎地关上抽屉、落下锁，眼底温柔尽收，他又是臭脸，又是讨厌女人、讨厌矫情的蒋誉。
板起脸，他拿起公事包，大步走出办公室，发现杜绢站在门口等着，她已经穿好外套，还上了淡淡的粉妆。
速度真快，他们的配合天衣无缝，娶她，将是最正确的选择。
走出办公室时，蒋誉瞥见会客室里的一抹蓝色背影。
是她想找他？哼，不必了，他对女人过敏！
第1章(2)
拥有一个心思缜密的女伴有什么好处？就是连参加慈善义卖都能顺利签下一纸合约。
别人的女伴带的是名牌包包和粉饼，杜绢带的是公事包和手提电脑，当别人的女伴搔首弄姿吸引满场男人注意时，杜绢已经打妥合约内容，并且传送到对方的电脑信箱里。
蒋誉很满意，没有她，他不会事半功倍，所以今天晚上，在送她回家的路上，一时兴起的他开口向她求婚。
可杜绢并没有像电视电影里面的女主角，被求婚时反应那样夸张。
高兴？有吧，她的嘴角有露出浅浅一笑，至于兴高采烈、欣喜若狂？他在她身上找不到。

只见她偏偏头，认真说：「谢谢你的求婚，我想我还需要时间考虑。」
那种态度好像在大卖场挑电视，面对售货员的热情推销，淡淡一笑说了句——「谢谢你的介绍，我想我还需要时间考虑」一样。
自傲的他怎么受得了？虽然他满意她不像别的女人，在听见求婚时，当，眼里立刻跳出两颗粉红色星星，大唱「明天就要嫁给你啦」，但她的反应未免也太冷漠了吧。
是欲擒故纵吗？不像。杜绢不是有心机的女生，可她的表现，多少挫了他高高在上的傲气。
他不是非娶她不可，只是他们在工作上的配合度，让他相信未来可以免去许多无聊争执，因为他不想在婚姻里浪费心思。
所以他直接问：「你要考虑什么？」
她的态度郑重。「婚姻是件很麻烦的事，有些事，我必须先想清楚。」
「哪些事情？」
「比方，婚后夫妻要财产共有还是分开，生不生小孩、要不要继续工作等等。老实说，我很满意目前的生活，若是因为结婚而大幅度改变……我真的需要考虑清楚。」她揉揉太阳穴，好像今天太忙太累，不适合讨论结婚。
他的魅力居然比不上财产共有或分开制？不过，蒋誉还是两个字，满意。
他欣赏她对婚姻的态度，没有晕头转向、无聊幻想，单纯的实事求是，和这样的女人共同生活，怎不合作愉快？
于是在他的坚持下，不管今晚适不适合讨论，他们还是找了间二十四小时营业的咖啡厅坐下来。
杜绢灌下一整杯咖啡因提神，
第一，结婚前三年不生小孩，以防婚姻不适合，还要为监护问题闹上法院。
第二，男方负责避孕问题，女方负责解决避孕失败问题。
第三，他们各自拥有自己的房间与隐私，在得到对方同意之前，不得越界。
第四，采财产分开制，但男方经济较好，所以每月提拨二十万元到女方的户头，让女方做为家庭用度支出。
诸如此类的条件有二十三条，她每条都详列记载，两人的态度都很正式，不知情的人还以为他们在谈公事。
凌晨一点四十七分，他们拟好合约，到超商列印下来，签定名字，杜绢在行事历里挑出三个月后一个未排定行程的下午，决定在那天公证。
蒋誉在驱车回家的路上松了口气。终于要结婚了，他又完成一项晴天的嘱咐。

慢慢的，他将完成她每一项嘱咐，然后十年、二十年、五十年，他的生命走到尽头时，他相信晴天定会遵守承诺，在生命出口处等候他。
他心情愉快，就像完成一项合约一样，非常有成就感。
把车子开到地下停车场，他搭专用电梯上楼。
他没和父母亲同住，独居，纯粹是喜欢自由。他的公寓在九楼，去年买的，是台北的高级地段，会选择这个房子，最大的原因是客厅里有一整面落地窗，可以俯瞰台北都会。
这里每户都独占一层楼，两百坪空间，四房两厅两卫浴，杜绢搬进来以后，客房可以给她住，两人共用书房、厨房和客厅，刚好符合她的要求——隐私。
content_en:
Everyone likes beautiful girls, and Du Juan is no exception. It is human nature to like this girl.
"If you don't like Tianyu, why don't you change your name to Tianqing? Wouldn't it be great if it clears up every day?" She chatted casually.
Suddenly, a hint of bitterness entered the girl's sweet smile, and she twitched the corners of her mouth.
"I think so too, but the sunny weather... will make someone very sad." The next second, she raised her pretty face and said, "Call me Xiaoyu, my friends all call me Xiaoyu."
"Okay, Xiaoyu." Du Juan smiled at her and took out the potato chips from the drawer to treat her. She guessed that Xiaoyu was hungry.
But when Xiaoyu saw the potato slices, she only seemed tormented, wanting to eat them but not wanting to eat them.
It’s just a pack of snacks, is it worth such hesitation? "What's wrong, are you afraid I'll poison you?" Du Juan asked with a smile.
"No, I have developed a habit. After eating snacks, I will...vomit."
Her eyes widened. "Spit?"
"Don't scold me. I know this is a bad habit, and I will slowly change it in the future." Xiao Yu held her head and begged pitifully.
It didn't take long for the two to become familiar with each other.
"Are you going to arrange for all the patient women to meet with me?"
Jiang Yu's voice drew Du Juan's attention back, and her eyes fell on him again. His eyebrows were raised, and his unhappy face appeared again, making her face turn gray.
He hates women who are pretentious and make themselves look pitiful. He also hates women who are smart and capable and use tricks behind the scenes. He also hates stupid women who are hypocritical and pretend to be stupid and weak... In short, he hates women.
Yes, he hates women, especially the kind of woman who comes to him, persists, and persuades Du Juan to speak for her!
"If I have the power." Du Juan smiled.
"Very good, Forever Watch. You can go downstairs.
"Yes, I'm going to inform that lady that you can't see her because you have to get off work. It's so pitiful that in order to see you, she didn't eat at noon and drank boiling water to fill her stomach." She put the documents in her arms and murmured lowly.
Do you think this will make him compassionate? Wrong, the bitter meat trick doesn't work on him.
"Don't bother me with this kind of thing again." His face was very smelly, and an uninformed person who was three meters away from him would mistakenly think that the sewage treatment plant was nearby.
"I know." Du Juan sighed and closed the door.
Jiang Yu put the magazine into the drawer and took out the group photo from the drawer.
Just take a look! He said this to himself, but this look made him unable to move away anymore, and he was filled with sadness.
How is his sunny day? Happy? Happy? Is there really endless Coke and lollipops there? Are there really so many men there that she feels comfortable pretending to be Wu Zetian? The sun there really doesn't shine on people, so why should she throw away the isolation cream?
Time stopped for him, the little girl in the photo smiled at him, and in a daze, he heard her laughter.
Her laughter was like a chick that had just hatched out of its shell, and her smile was full of warmth. Holding her warm face was like holding a fluffy golden chick.
At that time, she lay in his arms, pursed her lips and asked: "When I am not here, will you miss me?"
Think about it, why don't you think about it, think about it at night and during the day, until a big hole breaks in your heart, and the cold wind blows in from there, making him hypothermic.
Jiang Yu smiled bitterly, with a touch of sadness in his gentle eyes.
Gently, he put the photo back to its original position, carefully closed the drawer and locked it. His eyes were full of tenderness. He had a stinky face, and he hated women and the pretentious Jiang Yu.
With a straight face, he picked up his briefcase and strode out of the office. He found Du Juan waiting at the door. She had already put on her coat and put on light pink makeup.
The speed is so fast, their cooperation is perfect, marrying her will be the most correct choice.
When Jiang Yu walked out of the office, he caught a glimpse of a blue figure in the reception room.
Was she trying to find him? Hum, no need, he is allergic to women!
Chapter 1(2)
Have a thoughtful personWhat are the benefits of having a female companion? Even participating in a charity sale can successfully sign a contract.
Other people's female companions brought brand-name bags and pressed powder, while Du Juan brought a briefcase and laptop. When other people's female companions started posing and attracted the attention of all the men in the room, Du Juan had already completed the contract and sent it to the other party's computer mailbox.
Jiang Yu was very satisfied. Without her, he would not be able to achieve twice the result with half the effort, so tonight, on the way to send her home, he proposed to her on a whim.
But Du Juan didn't react as exaggeratedly as the heroines in TV movies did when she was proposed to.
Happy? Yes, there was a slight smile on her lips. As for being elated and ecstatic? He couldn't find it in her.
She tilted her head and said seriously: "Thank you for your proposal, I think I still need time to think about it."
That kind of attitude is like choosing a TV in a hypermarket, facing the salesperson's enthusiastic promotion, smiling slightly and saying - "Thank you for the introduction, I think I still need time to think about it."
How could he, who was so proud, bear it? Although he was satisfied that she was not like other women. When she heard the proposal, two pink stars immediately jumped out of her eyes and she sang "I will marry you tomorrow", but her reaction was too cold.
Is it playing hard to get? Not like that. Du Juan was not a scheming girl, but her performance somewhat dampened his arrogance.
He doesn't have to marry her, but their cooperation at work makes him believe that he can avoid many boring disputes in the future, because he doesn't want to waste time on marriage.
So he asked directly: "What do you have to consider?"
Her attitude was solemn. "Marriage is a very troublesome thing. There are some things I have to think about clearly first."
"What things?"
"For example, after marriage, whether the couple should share property or separate it, whether to have children, whether to continue working, etc. To be honest, I am very satisfied with my current life. If it changes drastically due to marriage... I really need to think carefully." She rubbed her temples, as if she was too busy and tired today to discuss marriage.
His charm is actually inferior to that of community or separate property? However, Jiang Yu still had two words: satisfied.
He admired her attitude towards marriage. She didn't have any confusion or boring fantasies, she was simply seeking truth from facts. How could she not have a happy cooperation when living with such a woman?
So at his insistence, regardless of whether it was a good time to discuss it tonight, they still found a coffee shop that was open 24 hours a day and sat down.
Du Juan drank a whole cup of caffeine to refresh himself.
First, refrain from having children for three years before marriage, in case the marriage is not suitable and the custody issue has to go to court.
Second, the man is responsible for the problem of contraception, and the woman is responsible for solving the problem of contraceptive failure.
Third, they each have their own room and privacy, and cannot cross boundaries without the other's consent.
Fourth, the property division system is adopted, but the man’s financial situation is better, so he transfers 200,000 yuan to the woman’s account every month for her to use as household expenses.
There were twenty-three conditions like this, and she recorded each of them in detail. The attitude of the two of them was very formal, and people who didn't know it thought they were talking about business.
At 1:47 in the morning, they drafted the contract, went to the supermarket to print it out, and signed their names. Du Juan picked an unscheduled afternoon in his calendar three months later and decided to notarize it on that day.
Jiang Yu breathed a sigh of relief as he drove home. It was finally time to get married, and he fulfilled another Qingtian instruction.
Slowly, he will fulfill every one of her instructions, and then in ten, twenty, or fifty years, when his life comes to an end, he believes that Sunny will keep his promise and wait for him at the exit of life.
He was in a happy mood, as if he had completed a contract and felt very accomplished.
He drove the car to the underground parking lot and took the special elevator upstairs.
He does not live with his parents, but lives alone, simply because he likes freedom. His apartment is on the ninth floor, goI bought this house in a high-end area in Taipei. The biggest reason why I chose this house is that there is a whole wall of floor-to-ceiling windows in the living room, overlooking the city of Taipei.
Each household here has its own one floor, 200 square meters of space, four bedrooms, two living rooms and two bathrooms. After Du Juan moves in, she can stay in the guest room, and the two of them can share the study, kitchen and living room, which just meets her requirements - privacy.
